header.goal: 1,400 sign-ups (GA4 sign_up key events) a month by 2027-10-31; the last 90 days averaged 946.7 a month (sign_up is the property's only key event, so keyEvents counts sign-ups)
sources_read: Meta Ads: the business's ad account
LinkedIn Ads: the business's ad account

checks.repeatable_channel: yes: paid search is core with 1050 key events in 90 days

where_results_come_from.note: Organic Search had 720 key events; 62.1% of visible Search Console clicks are non-brand, so SEO is credited with 447.1 and the brand part goes to not assigned.

roles_and_options.choice: in-house (the current content marketer keeps the role)
roles_and_options.rule: 0.75 FTE and covers a core area; in-house $7,500.00 is within 1.3 x the cheapest outside option (freelance $7,350.00, limit $9,555.00)
0.46 FTE, under 0.7 FTE: the cheapest priced option (freelance $4,882.50, agency $5,500.00, in-house $7,291.67)

leader.why: 3 roles report into marketing (3 or more) and the founder spends 10 hours a week managing marketing (over 8)
leader.choice: fractional head of marketing (2 days a week)
leader.rule: full-time $15,000.00 does not fit the $6,867.50 left after the roles; fractional $6,000.00 does

4 hours a month of the founder's time, in place of today's 10 hours a week managing marketing

build_order.step: Sign the fractional head of marketing
build_order.trigger: met: 3 roles report into marketing and the founder spends 10 hours a week managing marketing (limit 8)

build_order.step: Hire a paid media manager (Google Search, Meta and LinkedIn)
build_order.trigger: met: paid media needs 106.0 hours a month (0.76 FTE) at the planned $38,000 a month of spend

build_order.step: Keep the Google Ads freelancer until the hire's first month is done
build_order.trigger: ends when the paid media manager has run the account for one full month

build_order.step: Contract a lifecycle and ops freelancer (email, flows, tracking and reporting)
build_order.trigger: met: 65.1 hours a month of work with no owner today

build_order.step: Keep the content marketer on content and SEO
Replace the fractional head with a full-time head of marketing
build_order.trigger: people budget reaches $36,132.50 a month (today $28,000), or 5 people or vendors report into marketing

build_order.step: Move lifecycle and ops from the freelancer to the agency
build_order.trigger: 10 email sends a month (planned 6): lifecycle and ops then needs 82.7 hours, and freelance at $6,202.50 is more than 10% above the $5,500 agency quote
build_order.note: No in-house step for this role: it covers no core area, and the flat $5,500 agency quote stays under the $7,291.67 in-house cost at any volume. Ask the agency to re-quote at 10 sends; a quote above $7,291.67 would make the hire the cheaper option.

build_order.step: Split paid media into a search role and a social role
build_order.trigger: paid media passes 1.2 FTE (168 hours) at about $65,400 of monthly spend at today's mix (planned $38,000)
content and SEO passes 1.2 FTE at 23 pieces a month (planned 12)

budget_check.verdict: Fits: $27,132.50 a month against $28,000, $867.50 headroom. The one handover month with the Google Ads freelancer still on runs $30,532.50, $2,532.50 over; it is a one-off, so no role is cut.

findings: The first hire is paid media, not more content: paid search carries 48.7% of assigned sign-ups, and the planned $38,000 a month of spend needs 0.76 FTE. In-house at $8,750.00 beats freelance hours at $9,010.00 and is within 1.3 x the $7,000 agency quote.
SEO stays core after taking brand searches out: 62.1% of visible Search Console clicks are non-brand, leaving SEO 20.7% of assigned sign-ups. The current content marketer covers its 0.75 FTE.
Email, flows and tracking have no owner today and need 65.1 hours a month (0.46 FTE): a freelancer at $4,882.50 is cheaper than the $5,500 agency quote and a $7,291.67 hire.
A full-time head of marketing ($15,000.00) doesn't fit the budget yet; a fractional head at $6,000 does and takes the founder out of day-to-day management.
LinkedIn Ads cost $225.00 per conversion against $46.55 on Meta and $53.47 on Google. That is a media split question, not a team one; cross-platform-budget-allocator (if installed) covers it.
assumptions: Hours per area use the starting formulas in SKILL.md step 2; the company gave no hours of its own.
One full-time person = 140 productive hours a month.
Loaded cost = salary x 1.25 (the company gave salaries without taxes and benefits).
Salaries, freelance rates, agency quotes and the fractional quote are the company's own.
Planned media spend and output for the next 12 months are the company's own plan.
unknowns: Search Console hides rare queries for privacy, so the non-brand share is measured on the visible rows only.
Partnerships: the founder keeps them, so no hours were sized; referral is a minor area (3.5%).
